mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% over the past 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise >0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS and HOUST both rise >0.5% MoM (p>0.05 over 5-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months), reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is not significantly correlated with 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) annual rate above 2.5% signals rising inflation, triggering central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.2pp MoM (p>0.05 over 5-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: During declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95% of its 12-month average), weakening economic activity reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 95% of its 12-month MA.
